description: check against a lock an earlier sync left at v1: the source moved on (main is v2), a declared rule has no lock entry, nothing recorded what the scope rendered with; an installed file edited by hand is no drift (check never reads installed files) – the sync overwrites and names it, and check afterwards finds nothing. Through the CLI: check exits 1 (changed; --json names the drift) before the sync, 0 after it.
